tables.title: Past Progressive (الماضي المستمر)
rows: I was sleeping at 11 o'clock last night.
I was driving to work when I saw an accident.
My family was having dinner while I was working.
tables.explanation: يتكون الماضي المستمر من (was/were + V-ing). يستخدم للتعبير عن فعل كان مستمراً في الماضي، أو فعل مستمر قطعه فعل آخر، أو فعلين مستمرين في نفس الوقت.
tables.examples:
I was sleeping at 11 o'clock last night.
Lisa was reading a newspaper when I arrived.
My family was having dinner while I was working.

tables.title: Simple Past (الماضي البسيط)
rows: I went to Scotland last year.
tables.explanation: يستخدم الماضي البسيط للتعبير عن أحداث وقعت وانتهت في الماضي. مع الكلمات الدالة على الماضي مثل: yesterday, last year, ago, in 2010.
tables.examples:
I went on holiday to Scotland last year.
He didn't have a map.
They called the police.

tables.title: Prepositions (حروف الجر المهمة في الدرس)
rows: He found a job on a farm.
Distinguish the normal from the abnormal.
They couldn't find him because of the thick trees.
tables.explanation: حروف الجر تربط الكلمات في الجملة. بعض الأفعال تأتي مع حروف جر محددة ويجب حفظها كما هي.
tables.examples:
He found a job on a farm.
We waited for the waiter.
They couldn't find him because of the thick trees.

tables.title: Relative Pronouns (ضمائر الوصل)
rows: Mike is a student who used to work.
The student whose book is lost.
tables.explanation: تستخدم ضمائر الوصل لربط جملتين. who للعاقل كفاعل، whom للعاقل كمفعول به، which لغير العاقل، whose للملكية.
tables.examples:
Mike is a student who used to work in the summer.
They called the police who contacted the rescue services.

tables.title: Conjunctions (أدوات الربط)
rows: They were eating, so we realized it was a restaurant.
We felt afraid because nobody looked normal.
I was driving when I saw an accident.
Snow was falling while we were walking.
tables.explanation: أدوات الربط تستخدم لربط الجمل. 'so' للنتيجة، 'because' للسبب، 'when' و 'while' للتوقيت.
tables.examples:
They were eating, so we realized it was a restaurant.
We felt afraid because nobody looked normal.
I was driving when I saw an accident.

tables.title: Possessive Adjectives (صفات الملكية)
tables.explanation: صفات الملكية تأتي قبل الأسماء. 'their' تستخدم للجمع الغائب وتعني 'خاصتهم'.
tables.examples: Their hair and faces were also different.

tables.title: Past Passive (الماضي المبني للمجهول)
rows: The restaurant was booked for a costume party.
tables.explanation: يستخدم الماضي المبني للمجهول عندما يكون الفاعل غير معروف أو غير مهم. يتكون من (was/were + التصريف الثالث للفعل).
tables.examples: The restaurant was booked for a costume party.

tables.title: Quantifiers (المحددات الكمية)
rows: How much water do you need?
We have a lot of time.
tables.explanation: 'many' تستخدم مع الأسماء المعدودة الجمع، 'much' مع الأسماء غير المعدودة، 'a lot of' مع كليهما، 'little' تعني كمية قليلة وتستخدم مع غير المعدود.
tables.examples: We practised many activities like bungee jumping and mountain biking.

tables.title: Adverbs (الظروف)
rows: He didn't know the place well.
tables.explanation: الظروف تصف الأفعال وتأتي عادة بعد الفعل. 'well' تعني بشكل جيد، 'badly' بشكل سيئ، 'quickly' بسرعة، 'slowly' ببطء.
tables.examples: He didn't know the place well.

tables.title: Infinitives (المصدر مع to)
rows: We decided to go into the restaurant.
He went to find the way home.
tables.explanation: المصدر مع 'to' يستخدم بعد بعض الأفعال مثل: decide, want, need, try. يتكون من (to + الفعل في المصدر).
tables.examples:
We decided to go into the restaurant.
He tried to find the way home.
